dominant_strengths: Elegant serif/italic 'path forward' headline pairs beautifully with sans body, creating tasteful editorial hierarchy
Gold accent on the popular Studio plan reads as luxurious and premium without feeling gaudy against the deep navy
Numerals are huge and confident; price/$/mo composition shows real typographic craft
dominant_weaknesses: Middle card's elevation/glow is uneven — the gold halo feels heavier at the top than bottom, breaking visual containment
Three columns are visually similar in weight beyond the gold accent; hierarchy between Essential and Scale is weak
Feature lists rely on identical green checks across tiers, missing an opportunity to express tier identity through micro-detail
fix_priorities: Refine the Studio card's border/glow into a clean continuous gold stroke rather than asymmetric bloom
Differentiate Essential vs Scale visually — perhaps muted neutral vs subtle enterprise sheen — to strengthen the 3-tier story
Tighten vertical rhythm: price block, CTA, and feature list spacing vary across cards and break alignment
Introduce tier-specific iconography or accent color in checks to deepen system creativity
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral pull from the gold-on-navy luxury treatment, solid behavioral clarity in the comparison, but reflective payoff is limited because the layout is a familiar 3-tier pattern.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes — it clearly executes a premium pricing-table with monthly/annual toggle, a highlighted middle plan, and scannable feature parity, fulfilling the brief competently.
